body: 17 Nov 2026, P2-25 slice 4 gave this item its CLOCK and its INVENTORY (server/encore_server/tests/test_stopgap_expiry.py). Every STOP-GAP(P2-25 ...) marker in the server's source now says 'remove after 0.1.0' (the release that carries the pieces); the suite FAILS when encore_server.__version__ is past it, with the list to delete and what to run first. Assumption and limit: there is no release yet, so the clock is the server's version and the first release is assumed to be cut as 0.1.0; if it is cut under another number the test fails in that commit and says to move the markers. SCOPE OF THIS ITEM, complete list (the test's INVENTORY must be edited in the same change): (1) one-shot-repair: keyrepair._lost_by_old_fold, the worklist writes and the voided covers; refs.recheck_pending; the recheck_pending hold in refmerge; the ref_recheck line of ref_janitor; rehome.py (and its call in scanner.link_library, rekey_audit's worklist counts and the Rehome parts of its report); tests/legacy_fold.py; a NEW migration that drops ref_recheck (0018 is applied and is never edited: its comment carries no release); the shared copy helper repair_copy.py STAYS (keyrepair's permanent rewrite uses it). (2) skip-rule: the four guards of N-34's album_finder.py that refuse a name that does not survive the fold whole. Since slice 2 they fire only for a name with no letter or digit; N-34's tests decide whether a name of symbols is still refused, so removing them is not free: do it with N-34's rows, not by deleting lines. TRIGGER, unchanged: the worklist is empty on every install the project knows, READ not assumed (python docs/evidence/scripts/audit_stack.py check rekey --db <copy of each real encore.db> --python <3.12>), and one release has passed.
